answer: Make every identity earn its seat as a relay. First, the applicant registers a node pledging 200 GB of forwarding. Second, auditors inject watermarked probe packets, a pulse of test traffic at random hours, and check each exits intact within 300 milliseconds. Third, a node dropping over 2% of probes in seven days loses its seat, no appeal. Faking 1,000 nodes means renting 1,000 servers at $6 a month each plus $4,000 in bandwidth, roughly $10,000 a month before one fake vote. Like saffron, throughput cannot be faked cheaply: a cipher counts only after its relay carried traffic for weeks.
